best_match.fbbt_definition: For image, see FBrf0211729. Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the ad neuroblast (ALad1) lineage with dendrites that mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus VM2. This is the tenth cell type to be generated post-embryonically by neuroblast ALad1 (Yu et al., 2010). The axons of these neurons innervate a small area at the dorsoposterior edge of the lateral horn. There are around two of these per hemisphere, they fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract and they are cholinergic (Yu et al., 2010; Bates et al., 2020).
